message.content: One of the most iconic and widely recognized sculptures of the 19th century is **“The Kiss” (Le Baiser) by Auguste Rodin** (1889).  Created during the late‑Victorian period, it became a symbol of modern sculpture and is still celebrated today for its expressive realism and emotional depth.
